entries.headline: Dire Maul Tribute Chest Rewards Reduced When Resetting Bosses
entries.summary: The Dire Maul Tribute chest now drops less loot when players perform specific boss reset actions during the run.
entries.so_what: Adjust your farming expectations if you rely on repeated boss resets in Dire Maul for loot.

entries.headline: Balance Druid Talent Buffs
entries.summary: A hotfix has buffed several Balance Druid talents to make Starfire more viable and free up talent points for other abilities.
entries.so_what: Check your talent tree to reallocate points and test the viability of Starfire in your rotation.

entries.headline: Alterac Valley Security and Difficulty Adjustments
entries.summary: Blizzard adjusted Alterac Valley to incentivize objective capture over rushing the General. This includes increasing the difficulty of enemy creatures and buffing the behavior and sturdiness of Warmasters, Marshals, and Faction Generals.
entries.so_what: Expect longer matches and tougher combat when queuing for Alterac Valley.

entries.headline: Balance Druid Talent and Ability Revisions
entries.summary: Hurricane now hits correctly, Starlight Wrath reduces Starfire cast time, Moon and Stars grants Starfire pushback resistance, and Dreamstate replaces Moonfury. Moonkin Form now provides a 10% Arcane and Nature damage buff, and Eclipse increases Wrath critical strike chance.
entries.so_what: Review your talent tree as points have been reset and damage output is now tied more heavily to Moonkin Form.

entries.headline: Beast Mastery and Pet Critical Strike Fixes
entries.summary: Fixed a bug where pets had 0% critical strike chance on melee attacks and Summoned Hawks had 5% less critical strike chance than intended. Summoned Hawks now follow attack logic regardless of pet passivity and can be dismissed via pet bar.
entries.so_what: Expect your pet and Summoned Hawk damage to increase due to the restored critical strike chance.

entries.headline: Exorcism and Judgement Hotfixes
entries.summary: Exorcism can now critically strike, and Judgement debuffs will no longer fail to refresh from attacks if the remaining duration drops below 20 seconds. Additionally, the Oath of Light duration is increased to 60 minutes and riding skill bugs were addressed.
entries.so_what: Paladins gain increased damage potential and improved quality of life for debuff maintenance and mounting.

entries.headline: Poisons and Stealth Ability Fixes
entries.summary: Rogue Poisons and Blinding Powder are temporarily set to bind-on-pickup while a bug is addressed. A fix was also applied to ensure the Poised talent is correctly removed when casting Sap or Distract from Stealth.
entries.so_what: Be aware that you cannot currently trade or sell poisons until the hotfix is removed.

entries.headline: Chain Lightning and Maelstrom Weapon Fix
entries.summary: A fix was applied to prevent Chain Lightning from consuming Clearcasting if the Shaman simultaneously has 5 stacks of Maelstrom Weapon.
entries.so_what: Expect more consistent resource management when using Maelstrom Weapon procs.

entries.headline: Pet Critical Strike and Riding Skill Fixes
entries.summary: Warlock pets now have the intended critical strike chance for melee attacks, and a bug causing Succubus and Incubus to have 5% higher critical strike chance than intended was corrected. Riding skill issues were also resolved.
entries.so_what: Warlock pet damage output has been normalized.

entries.headline: Arms Warrior Talent Fix
entries.summary: The Weaponmaster talent will no longer fail to reapply correctly after a Warrior dies in Battlegrounds.
entries.so_what: Arms Warriors no longer need to worry about losing their talent bonus after a respawn in PvP.

entries.headline: Miscellaneous System and Dungeon Hotfixes
entries.summary: General fixes include Alterac Valley adjustments, nerfs to the Relevation Enchant, and itemization fixes for Unerring Purpose, Blackblade of Shahram, and Blackhand's Breadth. Dungeon interaction fixes were applied to Blackfathom Deeps and the Temple of Atal'Hakkar.
entries.so_what: Check your gear and quest logs to see if items or dungeon encounters you were struggling with have been adjusted.

entries.headline: Utilize Profession Cooldowns for Gold
entries.summary: Alchemists, Tailors, and Leatherworkers can generate consistent gold by utilizing their multi-day profession cooldowns.
entries.so_what: Ensure you are logging in regularly to reset your profession cooldowns to maximize passive income.

entries.headline: Alterac Valley Reputation and Zerg Strategy Changes
entries.summary: Blizzard has increased reputation gains in Alterac Valley while simultaneously introducing Tower Buffs for generals to curb the effectiveness of zerg-style strategies.
entries.so_what: Expect Alterac Valley matches to be longer and more focused on objective play rather than rapid boss rushing.

entries.headline: Night Watchman's Torch Can Be Used While Mounted Again in WoW: Forever
entries.summary: A hotfix restored the ability for players to use the Night Watchman's Torch while mounted.
entries.so_what: Use the Night Watchman's Torch freely without dismounting.

entries.headline: Revelation Enchant Nerfed in WoW: Forever
entries.summary: A recent hotfix nerfed the Revelation enchant, reducing endgame AoE damage for Druids.
entries.so_what: Re-evaluate your endgame AoE setup and enchantment choices for your Druid.

entries.headline: Revelation Enchant Nerfed in WoW: Forever
entries.summary: A recent hotfix nerfed the Revelation enchant, reducing endgame AoE damage for Mages.
entries.so_what: Account for lower endgame AoE damage performance on your Mage.

entries.headline: Revelation Enchant Nerfed in WoW: Forever
entries.summary: A recent hotfix nerfed the Revelation enchant, reducing endgame AoE damage for Warlocks.
entries.so_what: Check your AoE damage expectations and gear enchants on your Warlock.

entries.headline: World of Warcraft Forever Hotfixes Class, Dungeon, and Crafting Issues
entries.summary: Recent hotfixes for World of Warcraft Forever address various class, dungeon, and crafting issues.
entries.so_what: Check recent hotfix updates if you encounter bugs while crafting, running dungeons, or playing your class.

entries.headline: Proposed Druid Balance Talent Changes
entries.summary: Developers are considering merging the Starfire cast time reduction talent with the existing Wrath reduction talent in row one of the Balance tree. Additionally, the Moonfury damage buff may become baseline for Moonkin form and be replaced with a new talent.
entries.so_what: Expect these Balance tree talent adjustments to arrive in a future patch rather than a hotfix.

entries.headline: Proposed Survival Hunter Talent Adjustments
entries.summary: To compensate for the undertuned Survival capstone talent Lacerating Strikes, developers plan to buff Mongoose Bite's damage percentage and allow its effects to stack instead of overwriting.
entries.so_what: Watch for raid performance data results which will determine when these Mongoose Bite changes go live.

entries.headline: Planned Demonology Warlock Talent Consolidation
entries.summary: Developers plan to consolidate demon talents within the Demonology tree following community feedback.
entries.so_what: Look for Demonology talent updates in a future patch after dev design work is completed.

entries.headline: Warrior Arms Gameplay Status Update
entries.summary: Developers confirmed Arms Warriors will not receive significant gameplay changes at this time to prevent power creep.
entries.so_what: Expect Arms Warrior talents and abilities to remain in their current state for now.

entries.headline: Caster Itemization and Faction Writ Bug Fixes Announced
entries.summary: Future updates will introduce more level 15-40 spell power gear to address item scarcity for casters, while a fix and reputation boost are planned for bugged Azeroth Commerce Authority and Durotar Supply and Logistics Writs.
entries.so_what: Watch for added leveling spell power gear and fixes to broken reputation Writs in upcoming updates.

entries.headline: Feralheart Tier Set Fix in November 23 Hotfixes
entries.summary: The 4-piece Feralheart set now correctly grants 4 Energy regeneration every 1 second for 5 seconds.
entries.so_what: Feral Druids can now count on their 4-piece set bonus providing the intended energy restore.

entries.headline: Priest Ability Bug Fixes in November 23 Hotfixes
entries.summary: Mind Vision no longer procs unwanted effects, Dark Inspiration now grants the proper Spirit percentage increase when activated by Mind Flay, and Chastise can now be cast while in Shadowform.
entries.so_what: Shadow Priests can now freely cast Chastise in Shadowform and receive accurate Spirit scaling.

entries.headline: Destruction Warlock Intensity Bug Fix in November 23 Hotfixes
entries.summary: Fixed an issue where the Destruction talent Intensity was not working on Incinerate.
entries.so_what: Destruction Warlocks casting Incinerate will now properly benefit from the Intensity talent.

entries.headline: Mortal Strike Talent Bug Fix in November 23 Hotfixes
entries.summary: Fixed an issue that allowed Warriors to cast Mortal Strike from their spellbook without having spent a talent point in it.
entries.so_what: Warriors must now explicitly spec into Mortal Strike to cast the ability.

entries.headline: Sunder Armor Effects Reportedly Broken in WoW: Forever Dungeons
entries.summary: Community reports indicate that Sunder Armor armor-reduction effects are currently failing to function inside WoW: Forever dungeons.
entries.so_what: Tanks and physical DPS should be aware that armor reduction from Sunder Armor may not apply in dungeons until patched.

entries.headline: Retribution Paladin Bug Fix in November 19 Hotfixes
entries.summary: Two-Handed Weapon Specialization now correctly increases all Holy Damage dealt while equipped with a two-handed weapon.
entries.so_what: Retribution Paladins wielding two-handed weapons will see increased Holy Damage across their abilities.

entries.headline: System, Item, and Profession Hotfixes for November 23
entries.summary: Fixed issues with unintended weapon procs, World Buff retention across zone changes, Darkmoon and Fengus buff double-scaling, clam food Well Fed bonuses, and unlearnable profession recipes.
entries.so_what: Expect proper buff values and functioning crafting recipes across various professions and zones.

entries.headline: Dungeon, Item, and Race Hotfixes for November 19
entries.summary: Re-enabled the Seed Hybridizer with modified failure chances, made Motes of Unstable Magic soulbound, reduced dungeon encounter damage, and fixed racial discounts and cultivation bugs.
entries.so_what: Check seed crafting updates and note that Motes of Unstable Magic can no longer be traded or sold on the Auction House.

entries.headline: All Tier 3 Blueprint Locations for Crafting in WoW: Forever
entries.summary: Tier 3 workstations are required for high-level crafting recipes, requiring players to track down specific blueprint sources.
entries.so_what: Consult the blueprint source guide to unlock high-level crafting capabilities for your professions.

entries.headline: Blizzard Addresses Lack of Spell Power Gear in WoW: Forever
entries.summary: Developers Kris Zierhut and Aidan Moon responded to player feedback regarding a shortage of Spell Power gear options in WoW: Forever.
entries.so_what: Casters should expect adjustments or additional caster itemization options in upcoming content updates.

entries.headline: Developers Aim to Shift Away from Rigid BiS Gear Design
entries.summary: Senior Game Designer Aidan Moon stated that the development team wants to diminish reliance on fixed Best-in-Slot gear lists in WoW: Forever.
entries.so_what: Look out for broader gear choices and situational stat designs rather than single static BiS options.

entries.headline: EU Server Issues Affecting PvP Queues and Honor Gains
entries.summary: European players are experiencing bugs preventing Battleground queues from popping and disrupting Honor gains.
entries.so_what: EU PvP players should monitor official updates before focusing on organized Battleground honor grinding.

entries.headline: Combat Blade Flurry Hotfix
entries.summary: Combat's Blade Flurry will now correctly cause Shank’s damage to hit an additional target.
entries.so_what: Use Blade Flurry with Shank for correct multi-target damage.

entries.headline: Demonic Aegis Talent Fix
entries.summary: Fixed a bug where the Demonic Aegis talent effect could be snapshotted into Demon Armor or Demon Skin and retained after unlearning the talent.
entries.so_what: Do not rely on snapshotting Demonic Aegis; it is now correctly removed when talents are unlearned.

entries.headline: World Buffs Persist and Dire Maul Nerf
entries.summary: World buffs now persist through loading screens, but Fengus' Ferocity spell power from Dire Maul Tribute was reduced by 50% to 115.
entries.so_what: Take advantage of carrying world buffs through loading screens while accounting for the nerfed spell power buff.

entries.headline: Lockbox Peeking Temporarily Disabled
entries.summary: Players can no longer peek inside lockboxes due to a recent reroll exploit, though Blizzard noted the change is temporary.
entries.so_what: Expect a proper fix for lockboxes later since peeking is currently disabled.

entries.headline: Maximum Dungeons Per Hour Reduced
entries.summary: Blizzard reduced the maximum number of dungeons players can run per hour from 10 down to 5.
entries.so_what: Adjust your dungeon farming and leveling speed to stay under the new 5 runs per hour limit.

entries.headline: Stormshroud Armor Nerf
entries.summary: The Stormshroud Armor 3-piece set bonus was changed to a 3% chance on melee attack of restoring 18 energy.
entries.so_what: Reevaluate the value of the Stormshroud Armor 3-piece bonus following its nerf.

entries.headline: Blizzard Eliminates Targeted Layer Swapping
entries.summary: World of Warcraft Forever is moving to eliminate targeted layer swapping to combat mega-realm issues.
entries.so_what: Expect changes to how you move between layers in populated zones.

entries.headline: WoW: Forever Class and Itemization Updates
entries.summary: Developers addressed concerns regarding class balance, itemization, and the shortage of Spell Power gear, while also updating stats for crafted Tier Set gear in the first raid tier.
entries.so_what: Review your gear itemization and talent builds as adjustments to balance are ongoing.

entries.headline: WoW: Forever Hotfixes for November 19-20
entries.summary: Recent hotfixes include a fix for Retribution Paladin bugs, an LFG bug preventing groups from appearing, and security changes to prevent lockbox peeking.
entries.so_what: Be aware that lockbox-related exploits have been patched.

entries.headline: World Buffs and Dungeon Constraints Updated
entries.summary: World Buffs are now removed upon triggering any loading screen, and the maximum number of dungeon runs per hour has been reduced.
entries.so_what: Plan your travel and dungeon farming cycles carefully as world buffs are no longer persistent through loading zones.

entries.headline: WoW: Forever Leveling and Dungeon Optimization
entries.summary: Guides are available for the new Alcaz Prison dungeon quests, level 30-40 dungeon quest routes, and a new method for leveling Lockpicking to max without using BRD.
entries.so_what: Use these guides to optimize your leveling speed and prepare for dungeon runs.

entries.headline: Skyborne Mount Discounts and Dungeon Shortcuts
entries.summary: All Skyborne players now receive a 10% mount discount regardless of reputation, and a new 'Compound Key' allows for shortcuts in specific dungeons.
entries.so_what: Pick up the Compound Key to save time on future dungeon completion runs.

entries.headline: Targeted Layering Addons to be Disabled
entries.summary: Blizzard is moving to disable targeted layering addons by obfuscating realm ID API calls in an upcoming hotfix.
entries.so_what: Expect common layering addons to stop functioning in the near future.

entries.headline: PvP Ranking Structure Changes
entries.summary: PvP ranks are no longer calculated based on faction competition; players now manage separate Honor and Rank point totals.
entries.so_what: Adjust your expectations for progression as the competition model has shifted to individual point systems.
